objective_pt: Contar uma história pessoal com começo, meio e fim, usando passado contínuo para o cenário ("I was walking home when..."), passado simples para os fatos e conectores ("First", "Then", "Suddenly", "In the end").

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer lembrando de uma situação engraçada ou estranha.
prompts: Has anything funny happened to you recently?
What were you doing at eight o'clock last night?
watchFor: Contar tudo no presente ("So I go to the store and I see..."); no nível B1, treine o passado.
Dizer "I was walk"; o passado contínuo é "was + -ing".

exercises.prompt: You won't believe what happened to me yesterday.
accepted: You won't believe what happened to me yesterday
You will not believe what happened to me yesterday

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que você estava jantando.
exercises.listen: What were you doing at eight o'clock last night?
accepted: I was having dinner
I was eating dinner
I was having dinner at home
I was having dinner with my family
I think I was having dinner
I was making dinner
I was cooking dinner

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O passado contínuo é "was" + verbo com "-ing": "I was having dinner".

exercises.instruction_pt: Qual frase descreve uma ação interrompida por outra?
options: I walked home when it started to rain.
I was walking home when it started to rain.
I was walk home when it started to rain.
exercises.explanation_pt: A ação longa (o cenário) vai no passado contínuo: "I was walking". A ação curta que interrompe vai no passado simples: "it started".

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender conectores e expressões para dar ritmo a uma história.
prompts: How do you start a story in English?
watchFor: Usar "In the final" para "no final"; é "In the end" ou "At the end".
Repetir "and then" o tempo todo; varie com "after that", "suddenly", "luckily".

exercises.example_en: Luckily, someone found my wallet and gave it back.

exercises.meaning_pt: no final, no fim das contas
exercises.example_en: In the end, we missed the flight, but we had a great time.
It turned out that the man was my neighbor's brother.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "No final, deu tudo certo."
accepted: In the end, everything worked out
In the end, it all worked out
In the end, everything was fine
In the end, everything turned out fine
In the end, everything turned out okay
In the end, everything went well
In the end, it all worked out fine

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Dar certo" não é "give right". Use "work out" ou "turn out fine".
commonErrors.correction_en: In the end, everything worked out.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "No final" de uma história é "In the end". "The final" é a final de um campeonato.
commonErrors.correction_en: In the end, everything worked out.

teacher.goal_pt: Pronunciar a forma fraca de "was" e o final "-ed" em histórias.
prompts: Say "I was walking" quickly. Do you hear "wuz"?
watchFor: Acentuar "was" no meio da frase; ele é fraco: "wəz".
Pronunciar "walked" como "uólquedi"; é "wókt", uma sílaba só.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. O "was" é fraco e rápido.
exercises.prompt: I was waiting for the bus when I saw an old friend.
accepted: I was waiting for the bus when I saw an old friend

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. "Walked" e "stopped" terminam em som de "t"; "started" tem o "-ed" como sílaba.
exercises.prompt: We walked, we stopped, and then it started to rain.
accepted: We walked, we stopped, and then it started to rain

exercises.explanation_pt: Depois de som surdo (k, p, s, sh, ch, f), o "-ed" soa como "t": walked = "wókt".

teacher.goal_pt: Entender uma história curta e reagir com perguntas e comentários.
watchFor: Reagir só com "Ok"; ensine "Oh no!", "What did you do?", "That's hilarious!".
Perguntar "What you did?"; é "What did you do?".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça a história e escolha o que aconteceu.
exercises.listen: I was cooking dinner when the fire alarm went off. It turned out that I'd left a towel on the stove. Luckily, nobody was hurt.
options: Houve um incêndio grande e alguém se feriu.
O alarme tocou por causa de um pano no fogão, e ninguém se feriu.
O alarme tocou sem motivo enquanto ela dormia.
exercises.explanation_pt: "The fire alarm went off" = o alarme tocou; "I'd left a towel on the stove" = tinha deixado um pano no fogão; "nobody was hurt" = ninguém se feriu.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça o começo da história e pergunte o que a pessoa fez.
exercises.listen: So I got to the airport and realized I'd left my passport at home.
accepted: Oh no! What did you do
What did you do
No way! What did you do
Really? What did you do
Oh no! So what did you do
What happened then

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta no passado, use o auxiliar "did" antes do sujeito: "What did you do?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Oh no! What did you do?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "did", o verbo principal volta à forma base: "What did you do?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Oh no! What did you do?

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda que você estava andando de bicicleta quando caiu.
exercises.listen: How did you break your arm?
accepted: I was riding my bike when I fell
I was riding my bike and I fell
I was riding a bike when I fell
I was riding my bike when I fell off
I fell off my bike
I was cycling when I fell
I was riding my bicycle when I fell

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O passado de "fall" é "fell". Cuidado: "felt" é o passado de "feel" (sentir).
commonErrors.correction_en: I was riding my bike when I fell.
I was riding my bike when I fell.

teacher.goal_pt: Contar uma história completa de 1 a 2 minutos, com cenário, problema, reação e final.
prompts: Tell me about the most embarrassing moment of your life.
Have you ever got lost somewhere?
Tell me about a time something went wrong on a trip.
watchFor: Misturar presente e passado sem perceber.
Esquecer conectores; peça pelo menos três: "First", "Suddenly", "In the end".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu estava dormindo quando o telefone tocou."
accepted: I was sleeping when the phone rang
I was asleep when the phone rang
I was sleeping when my phone rang
I was asleep when my phone rang

commonErrors.correction_en: I was sleeping when the phone rang.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A ação que estava acontecendo vai no passado contínuo: "I was sleeping".
commonErrors.correction_en: I was sleeping when the phone rang.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Telefone "tocar" é "ring" (passado "rang"). "Touch" é tocar com a mão.
commonErrors.correction_en: I was sleeping when the phone rang.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Acabou que ele era o novo chefe."
accepted: It turned out that he was the new boss
It turned out he was the new boss
Turns out he was the new boss
It turns out he was the new boss
As it turned out, he was the new boss

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Acabou que" (descobriu-se) é "It turned out that", e não "finished/ended that".
commonErrors.correction_en: It turned out that he was the new boss.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Chefe no trabalho é "boss". "Chief" é usado em cargos como "chief of police".
commonErrors.correction_en: It turned out that he was the new boss.

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: While we were driving, the car broke down.

exercises.instruction_pt: Conte uma história real que aconteceu com você.
exercises.prompt_en: Tell me about a time when something unexpected happened to you.
guidelines_pt: Dê o cenário no passado contínuo: "It was a Saturday and I was...".
Conte os fatos no passado simples com conectores: "Suddenly...", "Then...", "After that...".
Termine com o final e como você se sentiu: "In the end... I felt...".

teacher.goal_pt: Fixar passado contínuo x passado simples e os verbos irregulares mais comuns em histórias.
prompts: What were you doing when you heard some big news?
Tell me a story in three sentences.

exercises.prompt: To cut a long story short, we never found the keys.
accepted: To cut a long story short, we never found the keys
To make a long story short, we never found the keys

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Enquanto eu esperava, começou a chover."
accepted: While I was waiting, it started to rain
While I was waiting, it started raining
While I was waiting, it began to rain
It started to rain while I was waiting
It started raining while I was waiting

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês a chuva precisa de sujeito: "it started to rain".
commonErrors.correction_en: While I was waiting, it started to rain.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Ação em andamento no passado: "While I was waiting".
commonErrors.correction_en: While I was waiting, it started to rain.

exercises.sentence: We ___ having lunch when the power went out.
accepted: were

commonErrors.correction_en: We were having lunch when the power went out.
